facts.fact: Techweez says the National Broadband Strategy 2025-2030 puts Kenya's current fibre at 40,000km and sets a 100,000km target.
The 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey found 81.9% of urban households and 48.8% of rural households had an internet user.

KEN.note: Names only the Digital Superhighway programme and a 2022 Digital Master Plan fibre figure; no strategy standing, text, period or reporting stated.
No government online service or portal stated.
Only planned fibre and a total network length; no contract, works, or capital-to-region service stated.
Only households with an internet user (61.6%) and mobile data subscriptions; no share of people.
Rural household electricity of 49.2% is from a housing survey, not the World Bank series.
